skill: humanizer (anthropic-skills), patterns from Wikipedia Signs of AI writing
rule: keep what each sentence says, change how it reads; no fact, number or claim added that the manifest or the source does not hold
scope: every README section, memo, method note and landing sentence before the v0.1.0 tag; the method is stated in report/templates/backlog.md.j2, so it was read there

not_in_scope.DECISIONS.md: a dated log; its entries are records and are not rewritten
not_in_scope.notebooks: records of dead ends, written by scripts/make_notebooks.py in the same pass of review

changes: bold labels on the two status lines removed (pattern 19)
the three NVD priorities stated once as three kinds of CVE instead of a run of repeated openings (pattern 7)
that gap named as the gap between the NVD priorities and the 24 hour warning, and the last sentence split in two
2026-11-12: the See it section, written after the first pass, read in the second; its finding line reads from the manifest and needed no change
the provenance sentence tightened, the two clauses joined with and
the fragment In one line each replaced by a sentence
the checklist caveat stated as what a written file shows and does not show (pattern 1)
the forced triad a template, a scoring habit and an editor replaced by the reason the bootstrap resamples filers (pattern 6)
the closer about the April announcement cut and its point moved into the sentence before (pattern 2)
The delay is not slow work; it is work not done restated as one plain sentence; the contrast stays because it corrects a likely belief (pattern 1)
The KEV promise holds, a staged fragment, made a sentence (pattern 2)
the question is whose replaced by the claim (pattern 3); almost every corrected to most, since the filer share is short of that
the unsupported weak one for its impact replaced by the three impact kappas read from the manifest
The agreement is between two labels, never with a truth folded into the sentence before (pattern 2)
the split KEV contrast made one sentence with because (pattern 1)
the Q7 fragment Across them today made full sentences
the AUC caveat stated as a caveat (pattern 1)
kept: the Q5 and Q6 headings, because they are the titles registered in evaluation/phase1_plan.yaml
the staged opener There is something to read instead merged into the sentence it introduced (pattern 4)
a starting point, not an answer restated as what a person still has to do (pattern 1)
measured honestly removed, a claim about the writer rather than the data (pattern 13)
the waiting sentence and the proposal sentence reworded for plainness
the closer Nothing told them otherwise, because nothing failed merged into the sentence before (pattern 2)
the common way such jobs go quiet reduced to a common way, the claim the memo can support
bold labels removed from the list of decisions; each decision still leads its line (pattern 19)
the defensive closer That is the rule working as written replaced by the reason the rule was written first (patterns 2 and 5)
the fragment row No NVD analysis, no CPE, so no finding made one causal sentence (pattern 2)
the map and screens leads written as sentences
the ruler caption no longer says real time, since the ruler is not live
A key, not a timeline replaced by what the key holds and leaves out (pattern 1)
the empty state no longer calls the bare grid one dot per day
the placeholder counted at step eight replaced by the share from the manifest (exposure.contrast.share_no_cpe); the line is left out when the manifest has no value
the opener Three ways in, a staged run up before a list of three (patterns 4 and 6), replaced by the sentence it introduced
every answer narrowed to every data answer, which is what carries X-Budget-Remaining
the two are held to each other, a vague connection (pattern 14), replaced by the test that holds them

read_unchanged.why: plain definitions; every sentence carries a fact
the contrasts name the alternative the decision weighed, which is what a decision record is for
procedural steps; the rule lines are rules, not rhythm
node lines are labels on a diagram
table labels and one sentence of fact
the statement is fixed text checked by scripts/check_statement.py
one label and one error message, both direct
every line is the registered plan or a manifest value set beside it
instructions and file names; every sentence carries a fact

checks_after: scripts/check_published_numbers.py (the rendered documents match the manifest)
web unit and end to end tests
